Why VTCFaRM

One partner from equipment to harvest

// 01
Factory Direct Manufacturing
We manufacture everything ourselves. No resellers, no middlemen. Direct factory relationship for better value and faster lead times.
// 02
Fully Customized to Demand
Container size, tier count, LED spectrum, irrigation type, automation level — every detail configured to your crop, space, and budget.

Smart IoT Control Systems
Integrated IoT monitoring: automated EC/pH control, CO₂ enrichment, temperature and humidity management, remote mobile access.

Crop & Agronomy Support

CE-compliant electrical systems. ISO-standard containers. Full warranty. Spare parts available worldwide.
Services & Solutions

From equipment to a complete running farm

01
Farm Design & Layout
Custom floor plans and facility layout design based on space, crop mix, and production targets. Full CAD drawings provided.
02
Turnkey Farm Supply
Every component — containers, racks, LED, climate control, irrigation — as one integrated package. One supplier, one contact.
03
Installation & Setup
On-site installation or detailed remote guidance with video support. Commissioning, testing, handover included.
04
Training & Operations
Hands-on training covering daily operations, nutrient management, pest prevention, harvest protocols, maintenance.
05
Remote Monitoring
Ongoing remote support, system diagnostics, software updates, response to IoT platform alerts.
06
Maintenance & Parts
Annual maintenance packages. Genuine spare parts stocked globally. Emergency dispatch within 48 hours.
